```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(emmeans)
```


#read in clade and PANGO lineage counts accessed June 5th  
```{r}
cladenum <- read_tsv("~/growthadvantagecompare/sequences_static/global-2.tsv") %>% mutate(variant = "clade") %>% 
  rename(name = clade)

#https://data.nextstrain.org/files/workflows/forecasts-ncov/gisaid/pango_lineages/global.tsv.gz

pangonum <- read_tsv("~/growthadvantagecompare/sequences_static/global.tsv") %>% 
  mutate(variant = "pango") %>% 
  rename(name = clade)

#https://data.nextstrain.org/files/workflows/forecasts-ncov/gisaid/nextstrain_clades/global.tsv.gz

#https://ncov-clades-schema.vercel.app
```
#List of pango lineages + clades to plot 
```{r}
names <- tibble(
  clade = c("21K", "21L", "22B", "23A", "24E"),
  pango = c("BA.1", "BA.2", "BA.5", "XBB.1.5", "KP.3.1.1")
)
```


#Plot counts of each clade and pango lineage combination 
```{r}
#restrict data to first appearance of clade (because clade is assigned when growth of pango lineage is high)

countplot <- function (clade, pango) { 

usa_pango_ct <- pangonum %>% filter(location == "USA", name == pango)

usa_clade_ct <- cladenum %>% filter(location == "USA", name == clade) 


mindate <- min(usa_pango_ct$date + 400) 
maxdate <- mindate + 730

bound_pct <- bind_rows(usa_pango_ct, usa_clade_ct) 
# %>% 
#   filter(date < maxdate & date > mindate)

plot <- ggplot(bound_pct, aes(x = date, y = sequences, fill = name)) + 
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Pango lineage and Corresponding Clade Sequence Volume") +
  theme_minimal()

return(plot)

}

plots <- pmap(
names,
countplot
)

walk(plots, print)

```
#Plot all sequences volume by day (should be the same)
```{r}
#tot n sequences per day

cladetotn_usa <- cladenum %>% filter(location == "USA") %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% summarise(totn = sum(sequences)) %>% 
  mutate("variant" = "clade")

pangototn_usa <- pangonum %>% filter(location == "USA") %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% summarise(totn = sum(sequences)) %>% 
  mutate("variant" = "pango")


ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = cladetotn_usa %>% filter(variant == "clade"),
           aes(x = date, y = totn, fill = variant), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = pangototn_usa %>% filter(variant == "pango"),
            aes(x = date, y = totn, color = variant), size = .1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("clade" = "coral")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("pango" = "steelblue")) +
  labs(
    title = "Total Sequences by Unit Over Time (Ensure consistency)",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Total Sequences",
    ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

#Plot proportions of clade, pango lineage by day 
```{r}

pangoprops_usa <- left_join(pangototn_usa, pangonum %>% filter(location == "USA"), by = "date") %>% 
  mutate(pangoprop = sequences/totn)

cladeprops_usa <- left_join(cladetotn_usa, cladenum %>% filter(location == "USA"), by = "date") %>% 
  mutate(cladeprop = sequences/totn)

```

```{r}

propplot <- function(clade, pango) {

  mindate <- as.Date("2021-06-01")

  usa_pango_props <- pangoprops_usa %>%
    filter(name == pango, date > mindate)

  usa_clade_props <- cladeprops_usa %>%
    filter(name == clade, date > mindate)

  pango_lab <- paste("Pango lineage:", pango)
  clade_lab <- paste("Nextstrain clade:", clade)

  ggplot() +
    geom_line(
      data = usa_pango_props,
      aes(
        x = date,
        y = pangoprop,
        color = pango_lab
      ),
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = usa_clade_props,
      aes(
        x = date,
        y = cladeprop,
        color = clade_lab
      ),
      alpha = 0.9,
      linewidth = 1.3
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = setNames(
        c("#1f77b4", "#d62728"),
        c(pango_lab, clade_lab)
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("USA Proportion:", pango, "within", clade),
      y = "Proportion of Sequences",
      color = "Variant representation"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

prop_plots <- pmap(names, propplot)
walk(prop_plots, print)

```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)

mindate <- as.Date("2021-06-01")

# --- Prepare pango proportions ---
pango_long <- pangoprops_usa %>%
  filter(date > mindate) %>%
  semi_join(names, by = c("name" = "pango")) %>%
  left_join(names, by = c("name" = "pango")) %>%
  transmute(
    date,
    prop = pangoprop,
    label = paste("Pango lineage:", name),
    clade,
    type = "Pango"
  )


clade_long <- cladeprops_usa %>%
  filter(date > mindate) %>%
  semi_join(names, by = c("name" = "clade")) %>%
  transmute(
    date,
    prop = cladeprop,
    label = paste("Nextstrain clade:", name),
    clade = name,
    type = "Clade"
  )


plot_df <- bind_rows(pango_long, clade_long)

# plot
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = date, y = prop, color = label)) +
  geom_line(
    aes(
      alpha = type,
      linewidth = type
    )
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c(
      "Pango" = 1,
      "Clade" = 1
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(
    values = c(
      "Pango" = 1.0,
      "Clade" = 1.0
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Pango lineage: BA.1" = "#ffe3b3",
      "Pango lineage: BA.2" = "#4a7f77",
      "Pango lineage: BA.5" = "#a3b686",
      "Pango lineage: XBB.1.5" = "#bcbddc",
      "Pango lineage: KP.3.1.1" = "#c8d6e6",
      
      "Nextstrain clade: 21K" = "#fed789",
      "Nextstrain clade: 21L" = "#023743",
      "Nextstrain clade: 22B" = "#72874e",
      "Nextstrain clade: 23A" = "#9e9ac8",
      "Nextstrain clade: 24E" = "#a4bed5"
    )
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "USA SARS-CoV-2 Variant Proportions Over Time",
    y = "Proportion of Sequences",
    color = "Variant representation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(colorspace)

mindate <- as.Date("2021-06-01")

# ---- Base colors per clade–pango combo ----
base_colors <- c(
  "21K / BA.1"     = "#1b9e77",
  "21L / BA.2"     = "#d95f02",
  "22B / BA.5"     = "#7570b3",
  "23A / XBB.1.5"  = "#e7298a",
  "24E / KP.3.1.1" = "#66a61e"
)

# ---- Prepare pango proportions ----
pango_long <- pangoprops_usa %>%
  filter(date > mindate) %>%
  semi_join(names, by = c("name" = "pango")) %>%
  left_join(names, by = c("name" = "pango")) %>%
  mutate(
    group = paste(clade, "/", name),
    label = paste("Pango:", name),
    color_key = group,
    type = "Pango",
    prop = pangoprop
  ) %>%
  select(date, prop, label, color_key, type)

# ---- Prepare clade proportions ----
clade_long <- cladeprops_usa %>%
  filter(date > mindate) %>%
  semi_join(names, by = c("name" = "clade")) %>%
  left_join(names, by = c("name" = "clade")) %>%
  mutate(
    group = paste(name, "/", pango),
    label = paste("Clade:", name),
    color_key = group,
    type = "Clade",
    prop = cladeprop
  ) %>%
  select(date, prop, label, color_key, type)

# ---- Combine data ----
plot_df <- bind_rows(clade_long, pango_long)

# ---- Factor levels for plotting ----
legend_levels <- c(
  "Clade: 21K", "Pango: BA.1",
  "Clade: 21L", "Pango: BA.2",
  "Clade: 22B", "Pango: BA.5",
  "Clade: 23A", "Pango: XBB.1.5",
  "Clade: 24E", "Pango: KP.3.1.1"
)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = legend_levels))

# ---- Build color scale ----
color_values <- c(
  setNames(base_colors, paste("Clade:", sub(" /.*", "", names(base_colors)))),
  setNames(
    lighten(base_colors, 0.4),
    paste("Pango:", sub(".*/ ", "", names(base_colors)))
  )
)

# ---- Plot ----
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = date, y = prop, color = label)) +
  geom_line(aes(alpha = type, linewidth = type)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_values) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Clade" = 0.9, "Pango" = 0.45), guide = "none") +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c("Clade" = 1.4, "Pango" = 0.9), guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "USA SARS-CoV-2 Variant Proportions Over Time",
    y = "Proportion of Sequences",
    color = "Clade / Pango lineage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
